title: Being universally closed descends along fpqc coverings (Stacks 02KS)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For $i\in I$ let $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ be the base change of $f$ along $g_i$, the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f_i$ is universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism] (for every morphism $T\to S_i$ the base change $(X\times_SS_i)\times_{S_i}T\to T$ is a closed map of underlying topological spaces) for every $i\in I$, then $f$ is universally closed.
